title: 2019 AMC 12B Problem 8
statement:
Let \(f(x)=x^2(1-x)^2.\) What is the value of the sum

\[ \begin{gathered} f\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2019}\right)-f\!\left(\tfrac{2}{2019}\right) \\ {}+f\!\left(\tfrac{3}{2019}\right)-f\!\left(\tfrac{4}{2019}\right) \\ {}+\cdots+f\!\left(\tfrac{2017}{2019}\right) \\ {}-f\!\left(\tfrac{2018}{2019}\right)? \end{gathered} \]

solutions.text:
Since \(f(1-x)=(1-x)^2x^2=f(x),\) we have \(f\!\left(\tfrac{k}{2019}\right)=f\!\left(\tfrac{2019-k}{2019}\right).\)

In the sum, the term with index \(k\) has sign \((-1)^{k+1},\) while the term with index \(2019-k\) equals it in value but has sign \((-1)^{2019-k+1}=(-1)^{k},\) the opposite.

Every term cancels with its partner, so the total is \(0.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Pair \(f\!\left(\tfrac{k}{2019}\right)\) with \(f\!\left(\tfrac{2019-k}{2019}\right),\) and compare their signs
